reuse.why: Introduces getMonthWideBudgetCategories and uses the existing extractTagsFromText, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own getBudgetData-based filtering instead of using the new selection.

duplication.why: The hidden and goal_def exclusions are written twice (helper SQL and copyPreviousMonth's inline condition), and the income/tracking check stays repeated in every action including the new one.

placement.why: Selection helper sits in budget/actions.ts with the actions it serves; the #fixed tag test is applied in JS after the SQL, which is acceptable but splits the rule across two layers.

scope.why: Edits are confined to the month-wide actions, the new handler registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Most actions share one selection, but copyPreviousMonth silently diverges (no #fixed exclusion), so the next rule change must be made in two places and is easy to miss.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in server/budget/actions.ts filters hidden/goal_def itself from getBudgetData rows instead of using getMonthWideBudgetCategories, and so misses the #fixed group rule.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth re-expresses the helper's SQL exclusions (hidden, group hidden, goal_def, includeHiddenCategories) as a JS condition over getBudgetData rows.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideBudgetCategories gained includeHiddenCategories with a '? = 1 OR (hidden...)' branch; copyPreviousMonth bypasses it with its own filter.
